description: Build and publish multi-page sites or slide-show presentations

index.Description: The whole Orbit workspace: build and publish multi-page sites or slide-show presentations. orbit.js is a classic script whose only job is to dynamically import modules/orbitMain.js and call initOrbit().

source_files.Description: Classic-script bootstrap that dynamically imports the ES module entry point.
Entry point: start-up order and the post-chat refresh hook.
Late-bound render hooks so action modules can re-render without import cycles.
The single mutable state object plus derived getters and persisted preferences.
Pure helpers: escaping, path classification, timestamp formatting, auto-grow textarea.
Upload, fetch, rename and delete one file at a time.
Draft folder listing, publish status, and project-reference cleanup on rename/delete.
Loads and caches this app's permission grants and re-checks before publishing.
Project records: load, create, switch, persist pages, delete.
Keeps slides.json and a deck's hardcoded slide list in step, and converts projects to slide shows.
Slide CRUD driven by the Slides tab: add, duplicate, delete, move, rename, preview.
CodeMirror mount, dirty flag, save, and the AI lock overlay.
Assembles the draft preview document (base href, tokenized assets, fetch runtime), refreshes the iframe, and opens the same document in a new tab for Draft.
Publishing and unpublishing pages and individual image assets.
Chat history, sending a message, and the two undo mechanisms (instant undo + checkpoints).
Renders the Chat tab: threads, streaming output, reply box and undo button.
Renders the Pages tab: page list plus the selected page's resources, URL and meta.
Renders the Files tab: draft file tree, folder view, rename/move/delete and uploads.
Hosts the slide-show panel and wires its handlers to the slide actions.
The Settings & Projects view: model settings, export/import, versions, transform, delete.
Full render, left-panel dispatch, chrome and splitter bindings, and global key handlers.
Durable project snapshots saved at the start of each chat thread, with restore and prune.
Lazy CodeMirror 6 loader.
Authenticated access to private userfiles via short-lived fileTokens.
LLM provider/model picker state, rendering and bindings.
Builds the Orbit system prompt, calls the LLM, and applies the returned file sections.
Standalone draft file-tree helpers (currently unused by the main app).
Parses the delimited LLM response, both streaming and complete.
Shim injected into the preview document to authenticate fetches and patch history.
Project export/import bundle building, validation and application.
Orchestrates publish/unpublish of a page, delegating paths, file I/O, image rewriting and sharing to modules/publish/.
Normalizes relative paths and computes which files a page's publish set includes.
Uploads bytes to a path, reads a draft file as text or blob, and syncs an explicit file list from draft to public.
Finds, publishes, and un-publishes images referenced inside a page's HTML, rewriting src URLs to their public copies.
Shares files with the publish_site permission and resolves canonical public ids, file records, and permission status.
Injects a <base> into the published HTML so relative run-time fetches resolve even under a custom short public URL.
Pure slide-show model helpers: slide list, deck page, manifest JSON, titles.
Starter deck HTML/CSS/JS and slide files for new slide shows.
Reconciles files, manifest and pages to work out what a project's slides actually are.
Rewrites a deck's own hardcoded slide-list array literal in place.
Works out which files a single slide alone uses, so deleting it takes only those.
Markup and event wiring for the Slides tab.
Bundled CodeMirror 6 editor.
App shell layout: root variables, toolbars, left/right panels, splitter, tabs and panel visibility.
Generic reusable UI atoms: buttons, select, icon buttons, banners, links and muted/hidden utilities.
Chat tab styling: threads, messages, thinking blocks, streaming, reply box, undo and checkpoints.
Editor/preview pane styling: CodeMirror mount, preview iframe, image/asset preview and the no-preview notice.
Files tab styling: file tree, folder view, uploads and publish-status indicators.
Pages tab styling: the page list, page detail panel, resources and meta fields.
Settings & Projects view styling: collapsible sections, project list and import/export controls.
Slides tab styling: slide list items, numbering, actions and deck status.
Mobile layout override that stacks the left/right panels below 800px width.
The animated globe used as the toolbar busy indicator.
Single mount point for the app.
Central mutable state object plus derived getters (draftBasePath, getActivePage, activeSlide, ...) and persisted left-panel-width/last-project prefs.
Pure helpers: HTML escaping, path classification, timestamp formatting, row normalization and textarea auto-grow.
Late-bound render hooks (render/renderLeftPanel/refreshPagesPanel) so action modules can re-render without importing shell.js.
Upload (text/binary), fetch and rename a single draft file.
Loads and caches this app's permission grants (publish_site, use_llm, allow_iframe_preview).

pages.description: Page specs with html_file, css_files, js_files

slides.description: Slide show only: ordered [{ id, file, title }] slide list

checkpoint_path.description: Path of the checkpoint saved just before this thread began (first message only); null otherwise
